title: Fallout 3 — Real External FOS Corpus Execution and Baseline-Nonspecificity Gate v3.2d
question: Does the v3.2c Fallout 3 structural save parser execute correctly on independent real .fos files, and what do those real files teach us about false-positive James runtime criteria before user T0/T1/T2/T3 saves exist?

established: strict FO3 header parsing executes on all fixtures
0x6E File Location Table parsing executes on all fixtures
ChangedFormsCount records are indexed exactly on all fixtures
Changed Forms parsing ends exactly at Global Data Table 2 on all fixtures
3-byte save RefID resolution executes with zero unresolved RefIDs in this corpus
FormID-array backed and CREATED RefID classes both occur in real saves
not_established: James-specific persistence across Tranquility Lane exit

header_context.meaning: These fixtures are external format controls, not a controlled Vault 112 James lineage. Their target records may only be used to discover nonspecific baseline behavior.

MQ04.xedit_flag_semantics: For QUST, ChangedFlag30/0x40000000 selects Quest Script; ChangedFlag31/0x80000000 selects Quest Stages.
MQ04.inference: MQ04 Changed Form presence is not a sufficient indicator of a Vault 112/Tranquility Lane event. In this corpus it behaves as an identical quest-script baseline fingerprint.

MQDadRef.xedit_flag_context: The xEdit FO3 Changed Extra mask explicitly includes bit31 among reference/actor extra-state triggers; its comment associates that bit with the CHANGE_REFR_EXTRA_GAME_ONLY class. Exact field-level decomposition of these 397-byte payloads is not yet admitted.
MQDadRef.inference: MQDadRef payload hashes can differ while change type, change flags, form version and payload length remain identical in unrelated external fixtures. Therefore raw payload-hash difference alone is not a James/Vault112 event discriminator.

falsified_admission_shortcuts.reason: MQDadRef exists in all three unrelated real-save controls.
MQ04 exists in all three unrelated real-save controls with an identical fingerprint.
All three external controls share the same ACHR header fingerprint but have different MQDadRef payload hashes.

minimum: exact plugin-manifest compatibility or an explicitly justified compatibility rule
MQDadRef and MQ04 target fingerprints at every timepoint
at least one no-op save pair near the same boundary
type-aware field decomposition for any candidate Changed Form whose payload difference is used as evidence
temporal localization of candidate changes to the Tranquility Lane/Vault112 boundary
revised_james_runtime_admission_rule.candidate_promotion_rule: A James runtime candidate may be promoted only when the observed differential exceeds the nonspecific baseline classes demonstrated here and can be localized to semantically identified fields or a newly materialized handle.

first_break_model.chain: REAL_FO3_FORMAT_PASS -> [CONTROLLED_JAMES_T1_T2_T3] -> DIFFERENTIAL_ABOVE_BASELINE -> TYPE_AWARE_FIELD_BINDING -> CROSS_EXIT_PERSISTENCE -> PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS -> IN_WORLD_SERIALIZATION
first_break_model.meaning: The parser now runs on real Fallout 3 saves. The limiting uncertainty is no longer format addressability; it is whether a controlled James lineage exhibits a semantically specific state transition beyond ordinary ACHR/QUST save-state baselines.

allowed: The v3.2c structural parser has executed successfully on three pinned real Fallout 3 saves from an external public corpus.
MQ04 and MQDadRef Changed Forms can exist outside a Vault112-localized test context.
MQDadRef raw Changed Form payload hashes can vary without changing its observed ChangeType, flags, version or payload length in this external corpus.
Future James testing must use controlled differential and type-aware semantics rather than presence or raw payload hash alone.
not_allowed: The external fixtures are T0/T1/T2/T3 James saves.
The different MQDadRef hashes are James memories.
A Changed Form difference proves Braun serialization.
SAVE JAMES is a vanilla executable rescue path.

next_gate.name: FALLOUT-3-ACHR-TYPE1-CHANGED-EXTRA-FIELD-BASELINE-DECODER-v3.2e
next_gate.purpose: Decode enough of ChangeType 1 / bit31 Changed Extra to identify which MQDadRef fields vary across the three real controls, so a future T1/T2/T3 candidate can be tested against a semantic baseline rather than only a payload hash.
next_gate.claim_limit: This decoder may classify runtime actor/extra fields; it must not label any field as autobiographical memory without an independent authored semantic bridge.
